interpretation: Broad provisional engineering bounds for a sensitivity experiment spanning small children and large adults; not validated population limits or fitted sample extrema.
outside_policy: Raise an explicit error; no silent clipping or adjusting limits to held-out results.
pca: Refit PCA without whitening on fixed-range-scaled training people. Rescale each PC using analytic extrema over the fixed input unit cube, so PC predictors also stay in [0,1] for in-range inputs.
classifier: Original L2 logistic classifier, C=1, linear and squared geometry, mask categories, face-by-mask/perimeter interactions, fixed threshold 0.5. Traditional models retain equal-person training weights; production ARKit retains original row-weighted BCE.
range_check_note: Initial mask bound 650 mm rejected two existing rows at 699 mm. Broadened the engineering mask limit to 800 mm before any fits; no facial ranges were changed or outcomes used to select limits.
